acceptance: An item at the ceiling is not quarantined
A quota wall and a logout add nothing to the count
No lane claims the subject; a passed card returns it
fix: Let cycle failure events raise the block count in go/internal/cycleoutcome. A quota wall and a logout add nothing. An item at the ceiling routes to the console with a digest of its findings. No lane claims it. A passed card returns it.
summary: Plan pipeline-blockers R4 and R5 are not built. Failed cycles do not raise the block count. A lane can claim an item that already failed past the ceiling. That is a wasted cycle.
title: Failure events feed the block count; an item at the ceiling routes to the console and leaves the lane queue
